posts.name: Nitin SV
posts.cooked:
I am encountering an issue while trying to access the questions for the System Commands section for BPT. I have successfully connected via SSH and navigated to my directory, but I am unable to locate the se2001 directory that contains the questions.

I have followed the instructions provided in the README file, and even manually created the se2001 directory . However, despite this, I am still unable to access the questions for the assignment.

Could you please assist me in resolving this issue?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
As mentioned in the video, you are supposed to make the folder for each question inside the ~/se2001 folder, which also you have to create.

Only after you create the folder with the correct name and cd into it, you can see the question using synchro show.

Please follow the steps properly, the questions should be visible.

posts.name: Shelly Porwal
posts.cooked:
Same issue I am also encountering on mac .Despite following the instructions ,not able to view the question statement .

Screenshot 2024-10-25 at 10.28.36 AM3118×1483 259 KB

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
1. it is not the same issue, it is different issue
  2. your issue is you are using light theme in your terminal, change it to dark theme.

The text is in white so it is not visible on white background.

posts.name: Shelly Porwal
posts.cooked: Thank you @sayan for the solution
